internal_path_methodology: Distinct same-origin anchor target pathnames; query strings and fragments are dropped, duplicate and trailing slashes are normalized, and root is retained as /.

root_excluded_reproduction.explanation: 595 is reproduced only by excluding the valid root path '/'; the canonical method retains root and therefore reports 596.
